public_rationale: Anthropic's September 2, 2025 announcement reports annualized revenue of approximately $1 billion at the start of 2025 and over $5 billion by August 2025 [e1]. Those figures do not establish January–September 2025 revenue or net AWS payments, so they cannot confirm or refute the claimed $2.66 billion versus $2.55 billion comparison [e1].
limitations: The packet contains no independent verification of January–September 2025 net AWS payments, including credits, discounts and prepayments.
The contemporaneous revenue estimate and its calculation have not been independently reconstructed.
Missing verification does not establish that either claimed amount is wrong.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Through September 2025 Anthropic spent $2.66 billion on AWS against an estimated $2.55 billion in revenue, more than 100% of its revenue.

statement.excerpt: Furthermore, I can confirm that through September, Anthropic has spent more than 100% of its estimated revenue (based on reporting in the last year) on Amazon Web Services, spending $2.66 billion on compute on an estimated $2.55 billion in revenue.
statement.document_title: This Is How Much Anthropic and Cursor Spend On Amazon Web Services

from_speaker: more than 100% of its estimated revenue
our_interpretation: The period is January through September 2025, as established by the surrounding discussion.
AWS spending means cash paid for all AWS services after discounts and credits, as the post specifies.
The denominator is an estimate of revenue earned during these nine months. It is not annualized revenue or financing.
The claim commits to approximately the stated amounts and a ratio above 100%; it does not claim that the revenue estimate is audited.
Accounting basis is estimate because the comparison rests on the author's reporting and estimates drawn from press reports.
criteria.support_condition: Independent billing records or independently sourced reporting establish approximately $2.66 billion in net AWS payments, and the contemporaneous revenue reports and stated estimation method justify approximately $2.55 billion for January–September 2025, with spending exceeding estimated revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable independent records materially contradict either amount, or show that net AWS spending did not exceed the revenue estimate justified by the stated method.
